description: Basic Unix authentication using /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow and /etc/group. Foundation for most PAM configurations.

parameter_help.sha512: Enables SHA512 password encryption for strong security
parameter_help.try_first_pass: Attempts to use cached password from previous module

pam_stack_example: auth required pam_unix.so sha512 shadow try_first_pass
notes: Standard module, typically first in auth stack. Provides basic password authentication.
